fields.name: ShardsValues targeted-value collection
fields.contract: ShardsValues is a mutable collection of targeted values keyed by a 16-bit shard identifier; its Shards property is an IDictionary<short, IDictionary<string, object>>. It can be constructed empty, from an existing shard-to-values dictionary (a null dictionary throws ArgumentNullException), or from an IList<short> of shard identifiers, which adds one shard with an empty parameter set per distinct identifier (a null list throws ArgumentNullException). Add(shardId) preserves an existing shard and otherwise adds an empty shard; Add(shardId, parameterName, parameterValue) adds the named value for that shard, creating the shard if needed, and throws ArgumentException when that name is already present for the shard; both return the same collection. Count and enumeration (IEnumerable<ShardParameterValue>) treat each empty or null shard mapping as one placeholder entry and each nonempty mapping as one entry per name/value pair. It implements ICollection: IsSynchronized is false, SyncRoot is a private lock object, and CopyTo(Array, int) writes the entries into the caller's array at the given index. Remove(shardId) removes an existing shard and has no effect for an absent shard. Merge(IList<short> shardIds) adds only shard identifiers that are absent, leaving existing shards and their values untouched; a null list throws ArgumentNullException. Merge(ShardsValues values) adds each absent source shard with a copy of its parameters (an empty parameter set when it has none) and adds the parameters of each already-present source shard to that shard's existing parameter set; it first checks every incoming parameter name, and if any is already present on the same shard it throws ArgumentException before changing anything, so the collection is left unchanged; a null values argument throws ArgumentNullException. ShardListForeign is a static overload family of 16 methods over List<> or IList<> collections of virtual compound keys or keyed models at one through four identity levels; every overload returns a new ShardsValues with one empty shard entry for each distinct shard identifier in the input that differs from the supplied excluded identifier.
